title: Reunion with Yuki after White Room
context: At a clinic Yuki wants Kiyotaka to speak to her; her wealthy father requests it
information_available: Request is personal; White Room principal gave no command to prolong interaction; Yuki displays distress
perceived_objective: Leave situation Kiyotaka judges harmful and unnecessary
observed_actions: Asks whether personal request is an order, declines when it is not, advises treatment and leaves
observed_result: Yuki becomes visibly upset and calls after him
epistemic_limits: Do not interpret stated rationale as proof of benevolence; no license to assume no emotions ever
alternate_outcomes_to_test: A direct institutional order would change the authority conflict but not guarantee empathy.
memory_seed_policy: Never import the canonical episode as an occurrence after a simulation divergence; pre-existing skills may be used only in character-behavioral calibration
